prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hero illustration for 'Find the patients who fit the question' in a clinical research demo. Premium tactile editorial paper sculpture, dark teal, sage, warm ivory and small ochre accents. Soft studio light on clean white background. Landscape 3:2, generous clear margins, simple composition suitable for a website half-width hero. No writing, letters, numbers, watermark or charts. Patient records represented by ivory folders with simple paper person silhouettes and highlighted quotation strips. Direction B: Sorting the records. An angled overhead still life of a broad collection of ivory patient folders flowing into three distinct shallow cardstock trays. The main teal tray contains a selected group, a smaller sage tray contains remaining records, and a small ochre-tabbed tray holds records needing more information. Paper person silhouettes on folder covers. A criteria card with three simple checkbox shapes beside the main tray. Strong spatial grouping, no arrows, no funnel, no text. This is a conceptual illustration, not an exact count.
